attributions.rationale: The construction "hung parliament" classifies the legislature by its distribution of seats, so parliament denotes the representative body in sense:001; sense:002 denotes the term or duration of a particular parliament and cannot itself have a hung composition.

The temporal frame "in the next parliament" locates reconsideration in the next parliamentary term, selecting sense:002; sense:001 identifies the legislative institution or body and does not provide the successive time unit meant here.

In "before Parliament", Parliament is the institutional body before which the bill has been formally placed, selecting sense:001; sense:002 is a parliamentary term or duration and cannot serve as the institutional recipient of a bill.

The phrase "lifetime of a parliament" measures the span from a parliament's formation to its formal end, directly selecting the term sense:002; sense:001 denotes the institution or collective body and is not the bounded duration measured by lifetime here.

The preposition in "during the current parliament" makes parliament the time span within which passage might occur, selecting sense:002; sense:001 is the legislative institution or body, not the bounded period selected by during.

The institutional source relation in "Act of Parliament" identifies Parliament as the lawmaking authority, selecting sense:001; sense:002 denotes a particular parliamentary term, which is not the enacting institution expressed by this construction.

The membership relation in "member of parliament" requires parliament to denote the representative body or institution in sense:001; sense:002 is a term or duration and cannot be the organization of which she is an elected member.

The phrase "during this parliament" uses parliament as the bounded interval for introducing the measure, selecting sense:002; sense:001 denotes the legislature as an institution or body rather than the time span licensed by during.

The complement in "elected to Parliament" makes Parliament the institution or representative body entered through election, selecting sense:001; sense:002 is a parliamentary term and cannot be the body to which a person is elected.

As the agentive subject in "Parliament passed the bill", Parliament denotes the lawmaking institution or its members collectively in sense:001; sense:002 denotes a term or duration, which cannot itself perform the act of passing a bill.
